p1: In this study you will see the continuity of the Old and New Testaments.
p2: Questions: What is the Kingdom of God? When did it come?
o1Bold: Old Testament Predictions of the Kingdom
o1NotBold: (The height of Israel’s glory was under the kingship of David approximately 1,000 B.C.)
o1c: Rock – cut out not by human hands (therefore God)
o1d1: Filled the whole earth – the vision for world evangelism
o1d2: Kingdom that will never be destroyed (v. 44)
o2Bold: New Testament Predictions of the Kingdom
o2b2: Kingdom will come in the lifetime of some of the disciples (Mark 9:1)
o2b6: Peter is given the keys (Matthew 16:13-19). Church and the Kingdom are the same and will be built on the truth that Jesus is the Christ (1 Corinthians 3:11).
o2b7: Joseph of Arimathea was still waiting for the Kingdom when Jesus died (Luke 23:50-51).
o2b8: Repentance and forgiveness of sins will be preached first in Jerusalem to all nations (Luke 24:44-49).
o3: Fulfillment of the Old and New Testament Predictions Acts 1-2 (33 A.D.)
o4a: The church is the Kingdom of God on earth established in approximately 33 A.D.
o4bText: As citizens of the Kingdom and members of the body (the church), we must be devoted to doctrine, to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread, and to prayer.
o4cText: We must seek His Kingdom first. Ask them to commit themselves to at least Sunday Services and Midweek Services.
